options.note: The model answers the Class 1 commands of the standard. Every PJLink device does, a Class 2 device too.
Class 2 extends Class 1 (device search, status notification, serial number, software version, filter hours, input resolution); a Class 2 model also carries Class 1.
Epson's network protocol (TCP 3629); carries ESC/VP21 commands.
Epson's command set over RS-232C; also inside ESC/VP.net and the Web API.
ESC/VP21 commands over HTTP when the Web API is switched on.
Crestron's control protocol built into the device; Crestron RoomView and Fusion monitor through it.
Epson's manuals describe an SNMPv1 agent that sends notifications (traps) to up to two addresses and document no objects a program can query.
Control from a DMX console or an application over Ethernet.

help.de: Was das Gerät selbst spricht, mit dem Namen der Norm oder des Herstellers. „PJLink Class 1“ heißt: das Modell beantwortet die Befehle der Class 1; ein Modell mit Class 2 trägt deshalb beide. SNMP: Epsons Handbücher beschreiben einen Agenten, der Meldungen (Traps) sendet, und keine Werte, die ein Programm abfragen kann.
help.en: What the device itself speaks, by the name of the standard or the maker. "PJLink Class 1" means the model answers the Class 1 commands, so a Class 2 model shows both. SNMP: Epson's manuals describe an agent that sends notifications (traps) and document nothing a program can query.
